narrative.overview:
A fact-checker that behaves like the chat assistant people already use: claude.ai's flow, with its own look. One question, one input, then a conversation. The world is graphite on near-white: a near-white ground, near-black ink, a white composer card and grey user bubbles, with no accent hue at all. Ink is the accent, so the four verdict colours are the only colour on the page. A dark twin on near-black follows the device setting; there is no theme toggle.

Plain HTML, CSS and JS with no build step. Every token is a custom property on `:root` in `style.css`, and a single `prefers-color-scheme: dark` block reassigns the same names, so both themes come from one rule set. The favicon (`mark.svg`) carries its own dark variant.
keyCharacteristics: Near-white ground (near-black in dark), a white composer card, grey user bubbles, unboxed replies.
No hue but the verdicts: ink fills the send button and draws the mark, focus ring, caret and selection.
Geist in every role, Noto Sans Devanagari for Hindi; one small size.
Verdicts as tinted badges pairing a colour, a drawn icon and a word.
Lucide-drawn line icons only; soft corners (0.5 / 0.75 / 1.25rem) and full pills.

rules.name: The Ink Accent Rule
rules.body: There is no accent hue. Interactive emphasis is ink; hover softens it by mixing 80% ink toward the ground, never by adding a colour.

rules.name: The Verdict Colour Rule
rules.body: Green, red, amber and the verdict gray appear only in verdict badges (and red in error text), each paired with its icon and word so colour never carries the meaning alone.

rules.name: The Twin Rule
rules.body: A new colour is a new custom property with a value in both the light `:root` and the dark override. Never hard-code a colour in a component.

rules.name: The One Small Size Rule
rules.body: There are two text sizes in conversation: 1rem and `--small` (0.875rem). Nothing else.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Changing numbers (the "Checked in Ns" time and the confidence percentage) use `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Geist everywhere, with Noto Sans Devanagari only as its Hindi partner. No serif, no mono, no second display face.

rules.name: The One Lift Rule
rules.body: Only the composer casts a shadow. Everything else is tone and hairline.

dos: Do set colour, size, radius and easing through the `:root` custom properties, with a dark value for every colour.
Do pair every verdict colour with its icon and word.
Do use tabular figures for any changing number.
Do draw new icons from Lucide, inline, stroked in `currentColor`.
Do keep every animation inside the reduced-motion reset.
donts: Don't add an accent hue or a second typeface.
Don't use the verdict colours outside verdicts and error text.
Don't add a text size beyond the display, 1rem and 0.875rem.
Don't give anything but the composer a shadow.
Don't add labels, instruction blocks, avatars, or copy that repeats the heading or placeholder.
